tools.name: traecn_send_message
tools.description: Delegate one instruction as durable background work; return taskId immediately. The gateway owns queueing, retries, recovery and persistence. Track that ID; never send progress probes.

outputSchema.description: Accepted task identity, original terminal replay, or gateway rejection with reason.

status.description: Accepted for new work, or the original terminal status on an idempotent replay.

taskId.description: Stable identifier used by traecn_get_task and traecn_cancel_task.

error.description: Original task error on replay, or submission rejection diagnostic.

ok.description: False when the gateway rejected the submission.

terminal.description: True when returning the original terminal task without submitting again.

result.description: Original captured result on a terminal replay.

tools.name: traecn_get_task
tools.description: Read task status and final result, or request trace for diagnosis. Read once on completion notification or after reconnecting; do not busy-poll.

taskId.description: Stable task identifier returned by traecn_send_message.

detailLevel.description: result returns only the final answer (default); trace includes the full visible Trae execution process.

outputSchema.description: Task status snapshot with final result or diagnostics.

status.description: Task status such as queued, executing, done, error, cancelled, awaiting_review, approval_required.

error.description: Original task error, or null when no execution error was recorded.

historyStatus.description: Internal history status when the task already left the active queue.

createdAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the task was created.

completedAt.description: Task completion time: epoch milliseconds, an ISO 8601 timestamp from persisted history, or null when unavailable.

fromHistory.description: True when served from persisted history instead of the active queue.

metadata.description: Gateway bookkeeping metadata recorded with the task.

result.description: Final agent answer payload: text, stable flag, elapsedMs; or code/error when unavailable.

errorCode.description: Stable code when the task itself failed.

lastStep.description: Most recent execution step summary (trace level).

detailWarning.description: Present when trace details could not be fully recovered.

tools.name: traecn_cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a tracked task at the next gateway control point. Return its ID and status; retain results already stored in task history.

taskId.description: Stable task identifier returned by traecn_send_message.

outputSchema.description: Cancelled task identity and any visible-generation stop outcome.

stopResult.description: Outcome of stopping visible generation when the task was mid-flight.

tools.name: traecn_stop_generation
tools.description: Stop visible generation in the named active conversation, with acknowledgement and an audit reason. It may belong to others; prefer traecn_cancel_task for tracked work.

acknowledgeUntrackedWork.description: Must be true to acknowledge that visible work may belong to the user or another agent.

reason.description: Concise reason recorded in the local security audit log.

outputSchema.description: Verified scoped stop outcome, or the active-conversation mismatch details.

requestedConversationId.description: Conversation ID supplied by the caller (mismatch path).

reason.description: Driver-reported failure reason when the stop failed.

tools.name: traecn_open_workspace
tools.description: Open and verify a local workspace before project-dependent work. Do not repeat its path in the task message.

outputSchema.description: Opened workspace identity with launch and verification details.

projectPath.description: Absolute folder path that was opened.

verifiedWorkspace.description: Workspace identity detected in the TraeCN window, or a compatible gateway path string.

folderName.description: Folder name detected in the TraeCN window.

rootPath.description: Detected absolute workspace root, or null when unavailable.

reusedWindow.description: Whether an existing window was reused instead of spawning one.

binPath.description: TraeCN binary path used by the gateway.

command.description: Launch command when TraeCN had to be started.

args.description: Launch arguments when TraeCN had to be started.

cdp.description: CDP endpoint coordinates for gateway control.

tools.name: traecn_list_models
tools.description: Discover available models and the current selection before choosing one. Auto may report manualModelsHidden without changing modes.

outputSchema.description: Current model plus available model names.

manualModelsHidden.description: True when Auto mode hides manual models from the native picker.

tools.name: traecn_select_model
tools.description: Select an exact discovered model and verify it. Already selected is a no-op; does not wait for capacity.

model.description: Exact model name as returned by traecn_list_models.

outputSchema.description: Applied selection with before/after models and queue readiness.

alreadySelected.description: True when the requested model was already active (no-op).

queued.description: Whether the model queue is busy after switching.

running.description: Whether generation is running on the model after switching.

canSubmit.description: Whether a new task may be submitted immediately.

queueDetails.description: Queue snapshot for the selected model.

tools.name: traecn_select_mode
tools.description: Switch to Solo or IDE and verify the active mode. Call only when needed; already active is a no-op.

outputSchema.description: Active mode after the switch.

alreadyInMode.description: True when the requested mode was already active (no-op).

tools.name: traecn_list_setting_sections
tools.description: Discover visible settings sections before any settings operation. Never guess section names.

outputSchema.description: Visible settings section names.

sections.description: Visible settings section names in UI order.

tools.name: traecn_list_settings
tools.description: Discover settings and control types in a listed section before changing values. Never guess labels.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

outputSchema.description: Settings and control types within one section.

items.description: Settings in the section with their control types.

tools.name: traecn_list_setting_options
tools.description: Discover dropdown choices before selecting a setting option. Use the listed section and label; never invent values.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

outputSchema.description: Selectable choices for one dropdown setting.

label.description: Setting label whose choices were read.

options.description: Selectable option texts in UI order.

tools.name: traecn_set_setting_toggle
tools.description: Set a discovered toggle and read back its state. Applying the current value succeeds as a no-op.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

outputSchema.description: Applied toggle value and driver outcome.

verified.description: True only when the observed UI value equals the requested value.

controlType.description: UI control whose value was read back.

tools.name: traecn_select_setting_option
tools.description: Apply a discovered dropdown option and verify it. Only values from traecn_list_setting_options are valid.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

value.description: Option value exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_options.

outputSchema.description: Applied dropdown selection and driver outcome.

verified.description: True only when the observed UI value equals the requested value.

controlType.description: UI control whose value was read back.

tools.name: traecn_set_setting_text
tools.description: Set a discovered text setting by section and label, then read back the field to verify it.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

text.description: Text content to enter into the field.

outputSchema.description: Applied text value and driver outcome.

verified.description: True only when the observed UI value equals the requested value.

controlType.description: UI control whose value was read back.

tools.name: traecn_list_conversations
tools.description: List current-mode conversations with stable IDs. Use when choosing or verifying conversation context.

outputSchema.description: Conversations for the current mode with stable identifiers.

mode.description: TraeCN mode the list belongs to (solo, ide, unknown).

active.description: Whether this conversation is currently active.

tools.name: traecn_create_conversation
tools.description: Prepare one new context, reusing an empty draft. Return its native ID when allocated; otherwise conversationId=null and creationDeferred=true until the first message. Call once per new context.

outputSchema.description: Fresh conversation or empty draft awaiting a native identity.

conversationId.description: Native identity when allocated; null for an empty draft.

recoverable.description: Always false for deletion; the gateway cannot restore conversations.

expectedTitle.description: Title compared against the visible conversation (delete mismatch only).

actualTitle.description: Title actually visible at decision time (delete mismatch only).

creationDeferred.description: True when TraeCN will allocate the conversation identity on its first message.

fresh.description: Whether the active context is ready for a first message.

tools.name: traecn_select_conversation
tools.description: Activate an existing conversation for subsequent visible interaction; return its confirmed ID.

outputSchema.description: Confirmed active conversation identity.

recoverable.description: Always false for deletion; the gateway cannot restore conversations.

expectedTitle.description: Title compared against the visible conversation (delete mismatch only).

actualTitle.description: Title actually visible at decision time (delete mismatch only).

tools.name: traecn_delete_conversation
tools.description: Permanently delete an inactive conversation using its listed ID, exact title and irreversible-deletion acknowledgement. The gateway cannot restore it.

acknowledgePermanentDeletion.description: Must be true to acknowledge that the gateway cannot restore the deleted conversation.

outputSchema.description: Deletion outcome, or title/active-state mismatch details.

recoverable.description: Always false for deletion; the gateway cannot restore conversations.

expectedTitle.description: Title compared against the visible conversation (delete mismatch only).

actualTitle.description: Title actually visible at decision time (delete mismatch only).

tools.name: traecn_answer_question
tools.description: Answer a pending visible question with the user-authorized decision; return the outcome. Call only for an unresolved interaction.

answer.description: The user's answer to the pending question.

outputSchema.description: Interaction resolution outcome with optionally resumed tasks.

resumedTaskIds.description: Gateway tasks resumed automatically after the interaction resolved.

tools.name: traecn_decide_approval
tools.description: Approve or deny the visible command card within user authorization. Approval revalidates expectedCommand and requires acknowledgeRisk plus an audit reason; denial needs only decision.

expectedCommand.description: For approve, the exact command returned with the pending interaction.

acknowledgeRisk.description: For approve, must be true after checking the command against the user-authorized scope.

reason.description: For approve, a concise authorization reason recorded in the local security audit log.

outputSchema.description: Approval decision outcome with optionally resumed tasks.

resumedTaskIds.description: Gateway tasks resumed automatically after the interaction resolved.
